Ethan Zhou: Hi all 1 I got an orientation invite but the event shows 07:00 on my calendar (I'm in CST UTC+8) and there's no Zoom link in the description. Did I get the wrong recurrence?
Onboarding Bot: Hello Ethan! There are separate orientation recurrences for AMER and APAC/EU. If the Zoom link is missing, you may be on the AMER series. Recording will be uploaded to Confluence under /onboarding/recordings after the session. Organizer: Clara Gomez.
Clara Gomez: Hey @Ethan 1 yep looks like you were added to the AMER weekly. APAC sessions are titled "New Hire Orientation (APAC/EU)" at 09:30 SGT. Quick join: https://zoom.us/j/2223334445
Clara Gomez: Passcode: redwood2026. We'll publish slides and a recording (with transcript) within 24 hours. Session lasts ~75 minutes incl. Q&A.
Ethan Zhou: If I can't make the live one, how long do recordings stay up? Can I request captions?
People Ops (Grace): Recordings are kept for 90 days by default. For long-term access or archival, email people-ops@redwood.com. Live captions can be enabled if requested 48+ hours ahead  DM me here to arrange.
Marco Ruiz: Quick calendar tip: Outlook sometimes shows DTSTART in Z (UTC) for subscribed series. If times look wrong, export the single-event ICS and import it rather than subscribing. That fixed it for me.
Ethan Zhou: Imported the ICS into Google Calendar and it displays correctly now 1 thanks everyone!
Clara Gomez: Welcome aboard @Ethan 1 ping me if you need account access sorted before the session. We'll drop the recording link in this channel after the call.
Onboarding Bot: Event metadata updated: region=APAC, recurrence corrected, attendees re-notified. :white_check_mark:
